Body.Content:
What and why

Microsoft Copilot and some apps or agents that integrate with Copilot will introduce additional content safety protections for users ages 13 to 17. This updated Copilot experience will be enabled by default for all users with Copilot access who are identified as a teen in Entra ID using the ageGroup attribute. These protections are designed to provide a safer and more age-appropriate Copilot experience. The protections will be enabled with no additional controls, for all users ages 13-17 who have access to Copilot.

Rollout schedule

  • General Availability (Worldwide): Beginning in mid-October 2026

Impact on your organization

Who is affected

  • Organizations that have enabled Microsoft Copilot access for users ages 13 to 17
  • Users ages 13 to 17 who are set to the teen ageGroup in Entra ID, are licensed and enabled for Copilot

Platforms and services

  • Microsoft Copilot
  • Copilot-integrated apps and agents where applicable

What will happen

  • Additional content safety protections will be automatically enabled for users ages 13 to 17 who are licensed for and have access to Microsoft Copilot.
  • Responses to sensitive topics may be more limited for users ages 13 to 17.
  • Copilot responses will be tailored to provide a more age-appropriate experience.
  • The feature will be enabled for all users defined by the teen ageGroup attribute with access to copilot.
  • No configuration changes are required to receive this update.

Action required and recommendations

No action is required.

We recommend that you:

  • Inform affected users and stakeholders about the upcoming experience changes.
  • Update any internal documentation that describes the Copilot experience for teen users.
  • Review and Manage Copilot access for Students in Education Tenants:
    • Ensure the Tenant Identifier in the M365 Admin Center is set appropriately with the correct K12, HED, or Other value.
    • Ensure students in K12 tenants are updated with the appropriate ageGroup value in Entra ID, so teens may be provided access to Copilot where appropriate.

Compliance considerations

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
